board.description: Board: writes and validates Intents, decides matters of judgement.

architect.description: Architect: turns Intents into Stories and job pairs, verifies finished Stories.

engineer.description: Engineer: turns one Story into code and test job pairs with exact instruction sheets; rewrites or splits a pair the Supervisor escalates.

builder.description: Builder: does exactly one code or test job from one instruction sheet.

analyst.description: Analyst: learns from the log and reports, writes wiki pages and gated proposals to cut cost.
